title.note: The question, verb first, about twelve words, in the person's own terms

context.note: What they need to know to decide, in three sentences or fewer

options.note: Two to four of {label, consequence}. Label under 40 characters. Consequence: one sentence on what happens if picked

recommended.note: The label of the option you would pick

reason.note: Why, in one or two sentences

by.note: Participant id of whoever raised the question, or aviator

source.note: Where the question came from: a file and section, a record id, or the conversation

choice.note: The label the person picked. Only they set this

title.note: One action that the decision causes
